description: Repairs r-str-ado-act/ado-execute-results: the connection ran in read mode (Mode = 1) and a later statement's recordsets stayed unbound after an earlier error. On a read-write ACE connection (own copy of r-fix-wire-ado-ado5), each statement on its own with Connection.Errors read and cleared right after: Connection.Execute of a row SELECT of ID, Code, T from K (State, BOF, EOF, CursorType, LockType, CursorLocation, RecordCount, all rows, Close); a SELECT with no rows (State, Fields.Count); the saved query QEmpty by name (state); a SELECT with adExecuteNoRecords (State of the result). Asks which return an open empty, closed or no Recordset.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
